verdict.rationale: Anthropic's product page states that Claude Code maps and explains entire codebases. It uses agentic search to understand project structure and dependencies without the user manually selecting context files. The overview docs and GitHub README back this up with claims that it understands the entire codebase and explains complex code. missing for 10: in-depth documentation of how agentic search explores a repo, independent or hands-on corroboration of whole-codebase mapping on unfamiliar projects.

support.subject: As a developer, I can have the agent map and explain an entire unfamiliar codebase without manually selecting context files

citations.quote: Claude Code maps and explains entire codebases in a few seconds. It uses agentic search to understand project structure and dependencies without you having to manually select context files.
It understands your entire codebase and can work across multiple files and tools to get things done.
